digest.component_or_area: link command and caused_by relation validation
propositions: caused_by links are unvalidated and accept targets with no referencing commits, creating untrustworthy causation edges and misattributions
the commit referencing scan exists only in close_precheck._referencing_commits and must be hoisted to a shared module for reuse across link and close operations
caused_by links must be refused when the target has no referencing commits, with --force as an escape hatch honored uniformly on CLI, library, and MCP
the refusal predicate must be called by both link_core and _link_dry_run to prevent the preview from drifting from the write behavior
the reconciler must allow inbound peer-authored caused_by edges with force="inbound reconcile: peer-authored edge" to prevent dropping valid cross-clone links
the rule must be documented in SKILL.md with a worked example for scope-of-work attribution edges on commit-less targets
